def myfuncPrimeFactors(n):
    """
    This function finds and returns the prime factorization
    of a whole number (excluding zero) via the reiterative division
    method.

    Example of usage:
      getPrimeFactors = myfuncPrimeFactors( 716 )
      print(getPrimeFactors)
    """
    i = 2  
    factors  = []
    while n != 1:
        if (n % i == 0):
          factors = factors + [i]
          n = n//i
        else:
          i = i+1
    return factors
